request.amount_ada: none requested; proposed net change limit is 500,000,000 ada
request.deadline: period ends at the close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Apply the limit to all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period and future enacted Treasury Withdrawals during the period
request.what: Agree a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713 via an Info action with no direct on-chain effect and no authorization of any Treasury Withdrawal.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only total lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger, and does not count Treasury inflows.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada limit and remain valid without being reset, reversed, re-opened, or re-authorized by this action.
The proposal states that this new limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epochs 613-713 period.
The proposer says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but practical room under it is becoming constrained.
The proposer says increasing the limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are sufficient to record DRep agreement to a Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal states that it has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal states it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to the enacted Constitution.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to establish a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, replacing the prior 350,000,000 ada limit for that period, with ledger-debited withdrawals counting cumulatively and inflows excluded.
